connector.name: PDF4me
connector.registryDescription: PDF & document automation via the PDF4me API - convert, OCR, extract, edit, secure.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.pdf4me.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package pdf4me-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pdf4me account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
